name: Alaska
note: Alaska has no state income tax on wages. Employees do pay unemployment insurance: 0.5% of wages up to the yearly taxable wage base, on top of federal income tax and FICA.

items.label: Unemployment insurance (employee)
items.note: 0.5% of wages up to the taxable wage base ($54,200 in 2026), at most $271 a year. Alaska is one of the few states where employees pay unemployment insurance.

notModelled: Employee unemployment insurance contributions (Alaska is one of three states that charge employees)
